description:
The purpose of this Request for Information (RFI) is to gather market research information for
understanding the Government’s options regarding Nuclear Surety Cross Check Analysis
(NSCCA)/ Nuclear Safety Analysis and Technical Evaluation (NSATE)/ Independent
Verification/Validation (IV&V) for the software for the Sentinel Weapon System. NSCCA/
NSATE is defined in AFMAN 91-119; test, simulations, and other evaluation techniques must be
used to prove the safety and surety of the weapon system and for a thorough software
verification process. The Government is evaluating Independent Verification/Validation options
for Nuclear Surety for software for the Sentinel Weapon System.
